assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: meadow-map, full-bleed landscape background illustration for an original children's scripture memorization creature-collecting game Scribbies. Output landscape 1536x1024. Beautiful high-angle isometric storybook game world map, a cozy green valley with rounded trees framing outer edges, little peach roof cottage near lower left, pale winding trail from lower left through broad open grassy central clearings to a small luminous ancient tree at upper right, turquoise brook and wooden bridge upper middle. Soft hand-painted 3D toy diorama, lush emerald mint golden greens, creamy sunlight, charming polished family adventure game aesthetic, painterly details. Enough open space for later overlay of six UI node markers around normalized positions (17%,74%),(35%,60%),(52%,72%),(68%,52%),(54%,31%),(77%,22%); DO NOT draw the markers. Whole landscape fills the frame, not floating on blank background. No characters, creatures, text, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, or baked UI.
